decision_rationale: BIOARC is presented as a new NAS framework for biological foundation models, but the provided text does not describe a decoder, autoregressive, or other generative mechanism. It does show foundation-model context through large pretraining corpora and transfer across many DNA/protein tasks.
evidence_snippet: "framework utilizing Neural Architecture Search (NAS)"; "pretraining, we use the full human reference genome GRCh38"; "10% randomly sampled UniRef50"; "pretrained large foundation models"; "novel hybrid architectures"; "no decoder/autoregressive generation described"; "BIOARC provides a data-driven methodology for developing the next generation of efficient biological foundation models"; "For downstream evaluation, we employ the human subset of the GUE benchmark"; "For evaluation, we select 6 tasks from the PEER benchmark"; "BPE is a subword tokenization strategy"
